status_values.CURRENT_WITH_CAVEATS: Usable with the listed limitations stated beside every number taken from it.
status_values.KNOWN_DEFECT: A record states a defect that changes a reported number or claim. Do not use the affected parts.
status_values.SUPERSEDED: Replaced by the entry named in superseded_by. Kept for history.
status_values.WITHDRAWN: Withdrawn at Pete's instruction. Do not use.
status_values.PENDING_RULING: Its adoption waits for a ruling by Pete.
status_values.UNCHECKED: No status record found. Means only: not yet used in a result that we quote. It is not a review queue; check on use.

external_registries.note: Merged here as module hydroacoustics (phase 2, 26 Oct 2026) from commit 6ebfc70d4d4f4b46ac57f2330eba4ffdf3df87df. The hydro registry stays the module's own record; its loader registry.py reads it.

defects.statement: Fuel-model audit finding F9: the time base of the 18:01:49 fuel in core-model-stages.md is wrong.

Old coupling value 2.1e-4 used as the F-35A "upper anchor". 2.1e-4 is Brown 2026's Arons-equivalent coupling, a different quantity. Under the module definition the F-35A value from Metz 2023 is 2.26e-3 (pending ruling). Every "x F-35A" multiple on 2.1e-4 is 10.8 times too high.

Diego Garcia (H08S) detections that coincide with airgun shots were ranked as candidates. 44 of 47 H08S single candidates lie within 1.5 s of a shot in h08s_template_shots.csv (chance about 30 %). The searches note itself said only residual rows are candidates (G-S9). Pete (23 Oct): a shot coincidence is not an exclusion; constructive interference and waveform distortion can still carry a detection.
Scott Reef 3250 used in pairs and triples although its path is blocked. 3250 carries no information (blocked path), but it is in most pairs and triples.

Detections in bands below the receiver pass band. 2-5 Hz members at IMOS (hardware corner 8 Hz) and on Kadri panels (5 Hz high-pass) lie where the recording chain strongly attenuates; a detection there is unlikely to be impact sound in that band (a corner attenuates, it does not remove all energy). Labelled G-S8 in the searches note but kept in the ranking.

Detection power measured only on model-matched templates. On the real F-35A arrival the M1b matched filter keeps only 0-3.4 dB of its model-matched gain; every P_D, eta50 and upper limit built on it is optimistic by about 4-10 dB.

Stand-in noise backgrounds used without approval. H01W/H08S use IMOS 3376 noise shaped to Blackman medians (proxy); 3315 and 3275 nulls come from the paired logger. Declared, but Pete requires approval for stand-ins.

Known events (Royer 2016) not removed from candidates. By the DIGITISED Royer marks, Kadri text time 00:52:03 lies inside the H01W-2 pick bar of icequake A (00:51:56.77-00:52:04.52) and caption time 00:54:30 is 5.9 s from the arrow for event 5 (00:54:24.06); Royer events 6 and 9 predict IMOS 3315 rows. Sensitivity: every digitised H01W-2 mark sits +7.7 to +16.6 s after Royer's Table 5 time for that event (other stations within about +/-5 s); against Table 5 the text time is +20 s from icequake A (00:51:42.99) and the caption time +17.6 s from event 5 (00:54:12.44). The figure-versus-table offset is an open question for Royer. "Time-consistent" is not identification.
Coincidences whose direct path to the receiver crosses land. Example: Kadri 00:40:34 row x Portland 3275; 201 of 2,000 path points above sea level in GEBCO 2026.
Flight-only Pleiades layer used as if conditional on the Pleiades objects. Early candidate maps used the "post" layer, which is flight-only.
Candidates A-F withdrawn. Withdrawn at Pete's instruction, 23 Oct 2026, for six stated reasons.
False "closed access / not held" labels on held sources (Metz 2023, Kadri 2019). Corrected on 22 Oct; the source-access ledger keeps the old label as an audit trail.

Kadri crash-panel timing check is exploratory with an incomplete model. Straight geodesic, one speed, no seismic (T-phase) path, inputs not from primary reports, H10S position not from the IMS station file, two events with assumed times. It is NOT evidence that Kadri's panel times are wrong.
Brief says the F-35A coupling is an "upper bound" because of a shallow channel. The Metz work found the shallow-channel effect +2.9 dB, NOT SUPPORTED at the 3 dB rule.

Coupling prior bounds 1e-6..1e-2 were an agent choice, not a ruling. Pete ruled 23 Oct that coupling is a prior range with its sources and the F-35A value is one point in it; the bounds are open. The agent-chosen upper bound 1e-2 lies below some F-35A one-factor values in the Metz note (2 m source 5.4e-2; f^-4 roll-off 1.3e-1), so the current prior truncates part of that range.
Old IMOS transmission-loss table (constant RAM correction, gap G-TL1) still used. Superseded by imos_tl_ram_arc.csv (RAM along the grid).
TL clamped at the table edge for rows outside the TL latitude span. 11-16 % of run J rows by stratum (17 Oct columns).
Searches covered only the pre-registered windows. Held IMOS records outside the windows (for example the CMST 01:34 event) were not searched; free known-event checks were lost.
Source depth fixed at 10 m in the MH370 chain. At the F-35A, 2 m or 30 m moves eta by more than two decades.
Cape Leeuwin and Diego Garcia p-values are not calibrated. Digitised plots at about 14.5 points per second with an emulated IMOS noise reference.

run-j-gated-v2 README states 3275 matches need coupling 30 / 19 (wrong). The text used the uncorrected pass-A IMOS TL. Corrected RAM-grid TL gives about 0.022 (01:20:35) and 0.014 (01:07:47) at the q99 run J energy (possible). README kept (hashed); erratum file beside it. The v3 README was corrected after generation.

Kadri replication: route lengths 1-4 % too long (erratum 2 of the wave-3 verifier). water_route.py sums 8-neighbour grid steps without smoothing. The Sriwijaya 182 and AB Aviation 1103 offsets are too negative by about 26 s and 84 s. The conclusions do not change (README).
